newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble edges down in cautious Monday trade.
newsitem.headline: Rouble edges down in cautious Monday trade.

text.p: The rouble edged down on Monday but dealers said fluctuations were small as banks were trading cautiously ahead of Wednesday's government bond auctions.
roubles/dollar Nov 25 midday Nov 25 early Nov 22 close
Dealers said rouble demand fell after funds had flowed in from other sectors late on Friday.

"So now banks are not selling or buying actively because there are plenty of roubles, but nobody knows what will happen tomorrow ahead of the auctions," Moscow Business World Bank dealer Alexei Glukhov said.
On Wednesday November 27 the central bank is auctioning seven trillion roubles of new six-month paper and an additional tranche of three trillion roubles of OFZ bonds.
Another dealer said trading is lively today despite small-scale fluctuations.
